summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for decision-map social preview posters and real-use-case demo refactor. Backend pytest: 18/19 pass; one new failure confirms share metadata/canonical/redirect are absolute but use HTTP scheme, breaking share-link open flow from HTTPS. Frontend: desktop and mobile layout checks passed (no horizontal overflow, laptop centered, callouts rendered, tabs/guided run/fullscreen/iframe functional, reduced-motion layout applied via media query). Critical integration bug remains in share-link redirect destination.

critical.issue: OpenGraph/Twitter/canonical/refresh URLs are generated with http:// (not https://) in this environment. Clicking generated share link redirects to http://.../map/{id}, which lands on an error page ('fault filter abort') instead of map page.

integration_issues.issue: share-open-link points to /api/decision-maps/{id}/share correctly, but backend share endpoint redirects to HTTP map URL and breaks destination rendering in browser.

action_items: Fix share URL origin generation in backend to honor HTTPS (prefer forwarded proto/host headers safely or explicit site origin env) for og:url, og:image, twitter:image, canonical, and meta refresh.
Retest share flow end-to-end: create map -> open share link -> auto-land on /map/:id over HTTPS -> verify view tracking increments and map renders.
Keep existing test additions in test_decision_maps.py; they now guard poster dimensions and share absolute metadata correctness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py share_decision_map currently uses request.base_url directly; under ingress/proxy this can resolve to HTTP and produce invalid social metadata URLs. This is a production-facing unfurl + navigation defect.
Real-use-case demo section has strong testid coverage for critical interactions (watch-demo section, callouts, channel tabs, scene tabs, guided run, fullscreen, iframe, share actions).
seed_data_creation: Created multiple decision_maps test records via public API during backend/frontend flow validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main blocker is HTTPS scheme generation on share endpoint. Evidence: pytest failure test_share_page_contains_absolute_metadata_and_redirect and browser run where share URL redirects to http://.../map/{id} causing 'fault filter abort'. If map URL is manually switched back to https://, page renders and VIEWING count increments.
rca of the issue: RCA: share_decision_map builds absolute URLs using request.base_url/request.url, which are proxy-derived and currently resolved as HTTP. Repro: create map from ShareScene, click Open the map, observe final URL becomes http://<host>/map/{id}, map page fails. Mitigation: normalize scheme to HTTPS when public site runs HTTPS (via trusted forwarded headers or explicit external site origin env), then regenerate all social/canonical/refresh URLs from that normalized origin.
